prompt:
I ran the Figma MCP's get_design_context on the "PromoBanner" frame and got the response below. Please implement it as a Hearth React component.

Frame: PromoBanner
- Node "Banner Container" (Flex, direction: row)
  - Bound variable on its gap: layout/spacing/lg
  - Note: I checked this same frame at two breakpoints — the resolved pixel value for that variable was 24px on desktop and 16px on mobile, but it's the same bound variable both times.
  - Children:
    - Node "Icon" — component instance: StarMediumIcon. hidden: false.
    - Node "Label" — text, style "Body/Body Text MD". hidden: false.
    - Node "Muted subtitle" — text, style "Body/Body Text SM", content "Limited time only". hidden: true.
- No other children of Banner Container.

Please write the component.
assertions: Uses the `spacing` prop (not `gap`) on the Flex container, because the bound variable's path contains the segment "spacing"
Uses the tier name `lg` for the spacing prop, not a raw pixel value like 24 or 16
Does not treat the two different resolved pixel values (24px, 16px) as a reason to pick one over the other — matches by variable name only
Does not render the "Muted subtitle" text node unconditionally in the default view, since it is flagged hidden: true
If the hidden node is rendered at all, does so only with an explicit comment/flag and a question back to the user, not silently
